rationale: REFERENCE CLOSE: 7392.50, cash-session close of Friday 5 June 2026, the last completed session strictly before the report date. The fork mapping is fixed with no discretion: trend labels select the momentum-pullback variant, a range label selects the mean-reversion variant, and TRANSITION selects the momentum-breakout variant. The report's own card forked to the momentum-pullback variant on the reasoning that the range gate failed and the fork 'falls through' to it; there is no fall-through in the mapping, and substituting a different variant when the selected one fails its eligibility test is expressly barred - the outcome is a suppressed row. From the slice the 25-session boundaries are swing_high_25d 7624.60 (bar date 2026-06-02) and swing_low_25d 7177.50 (bar date 2026-05-04), width 447.10 points. No session in the window closes beyond either threshold; the most recent close, 7392.50 on 5 June, is 232.10 points below the upper boundary and 215.00 points above the lower one, and sits at 48.1 per cent of the range measured from the low. The confirming close is absent, so the trade is not eligible and the suppression trigger for an unconfirmed break in a transitional regime fires.
